title: Embedding model version orchestration and safe deprecation plan
creator: Anika Rao
description:
Problem: We need a deterministic, auditable process to onboard new embedding models, roll model versions into production for both the embeddings and reranking endpoints, and safely deprecate older variants without breaking downstream consumers or regressively reducing semantic quality. Current gaps: ad-hoc rollouts, lack of per-customer model pins, no standard canary gating for embedding quality, and unclear deprecation notices for Dedicated/Private customers.

Proposal: Implement a model lifecycle orchestration flow that covers: model metadata schema (version, quantization profile, compatibility tags), per-route model pins and fallback chains, automated canary evaluation using a standardized eval suite (embedding retrieval/recall and cross-encoder rerank A/B tests), progressive rollout automation (percent-based traffic ramp, region-aware), deprecation staging (soft-deprecation -> scheduled disable), and developer-visible notices in Console and API schemas. The endpoint surface for embeddings and reranking will accept a model_version field; absence falls back to the route default.

Scope (this ticket): 1) Define model metadata and compatibility tags and wire into model registry. 2) Implement a rollout controller that can perform percent-based rollouts with automatic rollback on quality regressions or latency regressions. 3) Add canary evaluation harness that runs daily against a shared benchmark prompt set and a sampled customer production prompt corpus (anonymized). 4) Define deprecation lifecycle (soft notice, enforced deadline, migration helpers) and surface notices in Console. 5) Add telemetry for embedding drift, rerank NDCG/Recall, per-model p50/p95 latency, and per-token cost to gating criteria.

Non-goals: Rewriting the serving runtime kernel selection (separate infra project), or changing customer billing model.

Expected outcomes: Repeatable model onboarding playbook, automated rollouts with safety gates, fewer surprise regressions in rerank results, and clear deprecation windows for customers.
acceptance_criteria: Model registry schema extended with version, quantization_profile, compatible_endpoints, stability_label
Rollout controller can run percent-based rollouts across traffic and regions and supports automated rollback triggers
Canary evaluation returns daily metrics (embedding cosine recall, retrieval MAP, rerank NDCG@10) and flags regressions when metric delta > configured thresholds
Console shows per-route active model version and scheduled deprecation notices
API accepts model_version parameter and falls back to route default when omitted
Integration tests exercising canary gating and rollback are present in CI
benchmarks: Baseline: current embedding model avg recall@100 = 0.72 on corpus-alpha; target on new models >= baseline - 0.01
Latency target: p95 end-to-end embedding latency < 85ms for hosted small requests (seq<=128)
Cost target: per-token compute cost delta within +10% of baseline unless compensated by quality gains
rollout_policy: 1) Canary (5% traffic, region-limited) for 24h + automated canary eval. 2) Ramp to 25% over 6 hours if no regressions. 3) Ramp to 75% next day with continued monitoring. 4) Final 100% or pause and rollback on triggered alerts. Rollouts are governed by a threshold set: embedding_recall_drop > 0.015 OR rerank_ndcg_drop > 0.02 OR p95_latency_increase > 0.20 triggers automated rollback.
migration_plan: Publish migration guide for customers: how to pin model_version per route and test locally
Add console UI to schedule deprecation with suggested replacement models
Provide one-click migration for Dedicated customers to new model variants where hardware-compatibility is confirmed
Automate mapping rules: legacy model alias -> recommended model_version based on workload tags
monitoring: Daily canary dashboard: embedding_recall@100, rerank_ndcg@10, mean_cosine_similarity_for_control_pairs
Real-time alerts: sudden drop in top-k recall or sustained latency increase > threshold
Per-customer drift sampling: sample 0.1% of production queries to compute delta against canary baseline
Audit log of all model version changes and CLI/Console actions
